sentences.text:
Author: Juvvadi Sridevi
Bench: Juvvadi Sridevi
 The Honourable Smt. Justice Juvvadi Sridevi
 Criminal Petition No.16402 of 2024
O R D E R:

Petitioner, who is accused No.1 in FIR No.255 of 2024 of Station House Officer, Medak Rural Police Station, registered for the offences under Sections 406, 409, 420, 465, 468, 471 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code (for short 'IPC'), is seeking to quash the proceedings against her.

02. Heard Sri Gundaram Manoj, learned counsel for petitioner and Mr. Jithender Rao Veeramalla,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State-respondent No.1 and perused the record.
03.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the contents of the FIR do not constitute the offence under Section 409 of IPC as there is no allegation of criminal breach of trust by public servant.

He further restricted his prayer and sought for directions to the Police to proceed with investigation by issuing notice under Section 35(3) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (for short 'BNSS') (Previously Section 41-A of the Code of Criminal Procedure).
04.

Learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State-respondent No.1 submitted that there are specific allegations against the petitioner and that the petitioner created fake death certificate of her husband for the purpose of getting the benefit of 'Raithu Bandhu Scheme' and prayed to dismiss this petition.
05. As seen from the record, the averments of the FIR do not constitute offence under Section 409 of IPC.

Hence, this Court deems it appropriate to direct the Investigating Officer to follow the procedure laid down under Section 35(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) (Previously Section 41-A of Cr.P.C.) and also the guidelines formulated by the Honourable Supreme Court of India in Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar and another 1 scrupulously.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: However, the petitioner shall submit her defense and co-operate with the Investigating Officer as and when required by 1 (2014) 8 SCC 273 furnishing information and produce all relevant documents/material required for the purpose of the investigation and the Investigating Officer shall consider the same before filing appropriate report before the learned Magistrate concerned.
06. Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is disposed of.
As a sequel, miscellaneous application pending, if any, shall stand closed.
